I changed no code this run. The ladder is already in the game (v34.13 to v34.16), and only the re-measure is left. It needs `runA.sh`, `runC.sh` and the Chrome scripts, and none of those are on my command list. So `notes/coord-07/94-ladder-after` still doesn't exist.

I've invented no numbers. The old baseline, for whoever runs the re-measure:

| Run | p50 | p95 |
|---|---|---|
| A-t4 | 40.8 ms | 50.1 ms |
| C-t4, player 1 window | 148.5 ms | 187.1 ms |
| C-t4, player 2 window | 146.7 ms | 217.6 ms |

I added a note to `tools/handoff/console/notes/94-ladder-sheds-sooner.md`. It includes the watch line for his next play: a raid that turns softer or loses sparks while nothing is happening, or sparks or haze that come and go; the first 20 seconds of each raid should look like the rest.

The rung-0 and rung-2 firefight pictures were looked at in an earlier run. The critic scored them 2 or 3, about the whole HUD, not the ladder, so the 4 finish line is not met. Its fixes would reverse his later compact-corner and larger-health orders, so I left them alone.

TASK PARTIAL: the A-t4 and C-t4 re-measure, with new p50/p95 written beside the old ones in `notes/coord-07/`, is still to run on a lane that can drive Chrome.
